{category}geography.short_description: State name, or "United States" for the national total.
{category}geography.long_description: Geographic identifier as a human-readable name: a state name, or the literal "United States" for the national total. The matching FIPS code is in geography_fips. Only the 50 states, DC, and the national total are kept; territories and non-state NNDSS jurisdictions (for example New York City) are dropped. The ABCs file is national only, and even then covers a catchment of roughly 35 million people rather than the whole country.

{category}geography_fips.short_description: FIPS code for the geography; "00" is the national total.
{category}geography_fips.long_description: FIPS code for the row's geography, kept alongside the human-readable name so these files can be joined to other FIPS-keyed data. "00" is the national total and 2-digit codes are states. Stored as a string to preserve the leading zero.

{category}date.short_description: Period end date in YYYY-mm-dd (ISO 8601) format.
{category}date.long_description: End date of the reporting period. Resolution differs by file: the ABCs data is annual (YYYY-12-31), Epic Cosmos quarterly (last day of the calendar quarter), and NNDSS weekly (MMWR week ending Saturday). Named `date` per the bundle convention; the underlying standard files call the same column `time`.

{category}year.short_description: Calendar year, or MMWR year for the weekly NNDSS series.
{category}year.long_description: Year of the reporting period, provided alongside `date` for convenient filtering and grouping. For NNDSS this is the MMWR year rather than the calendar year, so it aligns with the `week` column and with the year boundary the cumulative count resets on.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|patho.short_description: Group A or Group B Streptococcus.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|patho.long_description: Which organism the row describes: "Group A Streptococcus" (Streptococcus pyogenes) or "Group B Streptococcus" (Streptococcus agalactiae). These are different diseases with different at-risk populations - Group A causes strep throat and invasive disease across all ages, Group B is primarily neonatal sepsis and invasive disease in older adults - so do not pool them.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|age.short_description: Age group; "Total" is the all-ages aggregate.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|age.long_description: Age group for the row. "Total" is the all-ages aggregate and overlaps the specific bands, so exclude it when summing across ages. ABCs bands differ by topic - rates use <1 / 1 / 2-4 / 5-17 / 18-34 / 35-49 / 50-64 / 65+, while resistance and typing use the coarser <1 / 18-64 / 65+. ABCs reports no 2-17 band for Group B, and its 18-64 / 65+ split does not line up with the 18-49 / 50-64 bands used elsewhere in this repo; both are source-determined.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|sex.long_description: Sex as reported by ABCs. "Total" combines both sexes and must not be summed with the Male and Female rows. Reported for Group A only; Group B rows carry "Total".

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|race_.long_description: Race and ethnicity as reported by ABCs, collapsed to White, Black, and Other. "Total" combines all groups and must not be summed with the specific levels.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|onset.short_description: Early-onset (0-6 days) vs late-onset (7-89 days) infant Group B disease.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|onset.long_description: Group B Streptococcus is the leading cause of neonatal sepsis, so CDC splits infant disease by onset timing: early-onset (0-6 days of life, usually acquired around delivery) and late-onset (7-89 days). "Total" rows are not onset-specific. The onset rows are a subset of infants, not additional population, so do not sum across this column - for case counts an explicit age "<1" / onset "Total" row is provided instead.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|syndr.short_description: Which clinical presentation the row describes; "Total" where not syndrome-specific.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|syndr.long_description: The clinical presentation the row reports, for the syndrome measures: cellulitis, bacteremia without focus, pneumonia, necrotizing fasciitis and streptococcal toxic shock for Group A; bacteremia without focus, bacteremia with pneumonia and meningitis for Group B. Syndromes are not mutually exclusive and do not sum to the overall case rate. "Total" on every row that is not syndrome-specific.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|antib.short_description: Which drug the resistance percentage refers to; "Total" where not drug-specific.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|antib.long_description: The antibiotic a pct_resistant row refers to. Group A is tested against penicillin, erythromycin, clindamycin, cefotaxime, tetracycline, vancomycin and (from partway through the series) linezolid; the Group B panel omits tetracycline and linezolid, so those rows are flagged not_reported. "Total" on every row that is not drug-specific.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|emm_t.short_description: Which emm type the row describes; "Total" where not type-specific.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|emm_t.long_description: emm type of Group A Streptococcus isolates - the M protein gene sequence type, used to track strain diversity and prospective vaccine coverage. Types CDC does not itemise in a given year are pooled into "other", and which types are broken out changes over time, so "other" is not comparable across years. "Total" on every row that is not type-specific.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|serot.short_description: Which capsular serotype the row describes; "Total" where not serotype-specific.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|serot.long_description: Capsular serotype of Group B Streptococcus isolates (Ia, Ib, II-V, the VI-IX groupings, and non-typeable), which informs maternal vaccine development. CDC's grouping of the rarer serotypes changed over the series, so some serotype levels cover only part of the years. Rows for 1997-1998 are placeholder zeros; treat the series as starting in 1999. "Total" on every row that is not serotype-specific.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|alph_.short_description: Which alpha-like protein gene the row describes; "Total" where not type-specific.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|alph_.long_description: Alpha-like protein (ALPH) surface gene type of Group B Streptococcus isolates - ALP1, ALP23, ALPHA, RIB, or "neg" for none detected - used for strain characterisation. CDC reports these from 2015 on. "Total" on every row that is not type-specific.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|value.long_name: ABCs Group A / Group B Streptococcus value
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|value.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column (see that column for units).
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|value.long_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column. Units are mixed across measures - rates per 100,000, estimated counts, and percentages - so always filter or facet by `measure` before plotting. Note in particular that rate_cases and rate_cases_by_onset use DIFFERENT denominators (the age band on the row versus the general population) and must never be added or shown on one axis; see the measure column for detail. Where a percentage has a published denominator it is in n_isolates on the same row.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_iso.short_description: Denominator behind the percentage on this row; missing where CDC did not publish it.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_iso.long_description: Number of invasive isolates behind the percentage on this row - the denominator for pct_resistant, pct_emm_type, pct_serotype and pct_alph_type. Kept on the same row rather than as its own measure so a tooltip can read "26.4% of 3,908 isolates" from one line. Missing on rows where CDC does not publish an isolate count for that group and year (most of the resistance series), which is a gap in the source, not a join failure. Empty for the rate and count measures, which have no isolate denominator.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_typ.long_name: Number of isolates of this type
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_typ.short_description: Numerator behind the percentage, for emm types only.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|n_typ.long_description: Number of isolates of the specific emm type on this row - the numerator behind pct_emm_type, with n_isolates as the denominator. Kept on the same row so a tooltip can read "emm1: 22.5% (99 of 440 isolates)" from one line. CDC publishes per-type counts only for Group A emm typing, so this is empty for serotypes, ALPH types and every non-typing measure.

bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|not_r.long_name: Flag for measures the source did not report
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|not_r.short_description: 1 where CDC did not report this measure for this row (value is missing); 0 otherwise.
bundle_gas/dist/abcs_strep.parquet|not_r.long_description: 1 where CDC did not report the row's measure for that combination of year, pathogen and stratification, in which case value is missing; 0 otherwise. These gaps are structural - a measure not published for a given stratification, an antibiotic absent from a pathogen's susceptibility panel, or an emm type or serotype not itemised that year - rather than values suppressed for confidentiality. Nothing is imputed, so a flagged row must not be read as a zero. Measures that simply do not apply to a row are omitted rather than flagged: the two case-rate measures are mutually exclusive by onset, so only the applicable one appears.

bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|age.short_description: Age group; "Total" is the all-ages aggregate.
bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|age.long_description: Age group for the row. "Total" is the all-ages aggregate and overlaps the specific bands, so exclude it when summing across ages. ABCs bands differ by topic - rates use <1 / 1 / 2-4 / 5-17 / 18-34 / 35-49 / 50-64 / 65+, while resistance and typing use the coarser <1 / 18-64 / 65+. ABCs reports no 2-17 band for Group B, and its 18-64 / 65+ split does not line up with the 18-49 / 50-64 bands used elsewhere in this repo; both are source-determined.

bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|value.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column (see that column for units).
bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|value.long_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column. Units are mixed: n_strep_throat and n_patients are patient counts, pct_strep_throat is a percent (0-100). Always filter or facet by measure before plotting. The denominator counts patients with ANY encounter, not emergency department visits only, so pct_strep_throat is not an ED visit share.

bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|suppres.long_name: Suppression flag for this measure value
bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|suppres.short_description: 1 if Epic suppressed the underlying cell and the value was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise.
bundle_gas/dist/epic_gas.parquet|suppres.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos withheld the underlying cell (a count of 10 or fewer) and the value was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. Measure-specific: for n_strep_throat and pct_strep_throat it reflects suppression of the strep throat numerator, and for n_patients the patient-total denominator. Computed upstream before imputation, so it records what Epic withheld rather than what the ingest wrote. Distinct from not_reported in the ABCs file, which marks data the source never published at all.

stss_cases_weekly.long_name: Weekly incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome
stss_cases_weekly.short_description: Newly reported STSS cases in the MMWR week.
stss_cases_weekly.long_description: Incident cases of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome newly reported in the MMWR week, derived by build.R as the week-over-week difference in the cumulative year-to-date count within each geography and MMWR year. This is the series to plot. NNDSS sometimes revises earlier weeks downward, which produces a small number of negative increments; following the bundle_measles convention these are kept as reported for transparency rather than clamped, and plots should cut the y axis at 0 instead. Note STSS is the only Group A measure NNDSS carries - invasive Group A disease generally, and Group B disease, are not nationally notifiable.

bundle_gas/dist/nnds_stss.parquet|value.short_description: Value of the measure named in the measure column (see that column for units).
bundle_gas/dist/nnds_stss.parquet|value.long_description: Reported case count of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome. The measure column distinguishes the weekly-incident series from the cumulative year-to-date series as published by NNDSS. The two are not additive - do not sum across measures.

bundle_gas/dist/nnds_stss.parquet|week.short_description: MMWR week number (1-53) within the MMWR year.
bundle_gas/dist/nnds_stss.parquet|week.long_description: MMWR (epidemiological) week number within `year`, provided alongside `date` for the weekly NNDSS series. The cumulative count published by NNDSS resets at week 1 of each MMWR year, which is the boundary build.R de-accumulates within.
